name: Commerce Township
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Commerce Township, MI: the township tree lighting with Santa, Glenlore Trails Aurora lights and Bowl with Santa at Wonderland Lanes.
lede: Commerce Township celebrates with a free tree lighting at the Richardson Senior Center, a woodland light trail at Glenlore Trails and a Santa day at the bowling alley.
celebrates: Commerce Township Parks and Recreation and the Charter Township of Commerce host the annual tree lighting at the Richardson Senior Center, with a winter trail, cocoa bar, crafts, face painting, hot dogs and Santa. Toys for Tots collects new toys at the event. Glenlore Trails turns its paths into Aurora Winter Wizards, an evening light experience from November 20 to December 27, with Santa visits December 18 to 20. Wonderland Lanes, a bowling center, hosts Bowl with Santa for families.
lastyear: The township's tree lighting page shows photos from the 2025 tree lighting, and the Richardson Senior Center's Facebook page has invited grandchildren to come meet Santa at the annual event. We did not find a written host recap of 2025, so this section does not add details beyond that. The township treats the tree lighting as a yearly event with named sponsors.
facts: The tree lighting takes place at the Richardson Senior Center, 1485 E Oakley Park Road, and the township thanks a list of sponsors on its tree lighting page. The event runs from 4:30 to 7:30 pm. Glenlore Trails is at 3860 Newton Road, and Wonderland Lanes is at 8265 Richardson Road. The township lists the tree lighting as free to attend.

faq: How does Commerce Township celebrate Christmas?

With a free tree lighting at the Richardson Senior Center, a woodland light trail at Glenlore Trails and a Bowl with Santa event at Wonderland Lanes. The township tree lighting is run by Commerce Township Parks and Recreation with the Charter Township of Commerce, and Toys for Tots collects new toys at the event.
When is the Commerce Township tree lighting?

Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 4:30 to 7:30 pm at the Richardson Senior Center, 1485 E Oakley Park Rd. It is free, and the township lists a winter trail, cocoa bar, crafts, face painting, hot dogs and Santa. Dress warmly because part of the evening is outdoors and the trail is outside.
What can kids do at the tree lighting?

Kids can walk the winter trail, visit the cocoa bar, make crafts, get their faces painted and meet Santa. Hot dogs are served, and Toys for Tots takes new toy donations, so bring an unwrapped toy if you want to give one. The township lists the whole evening as free to attend.

Aurora Winter Wizards at Glenlore Trails opens November 20, 2026 and runs Thursday to Sunday evenings through December 27. Santa visits December 18 to 20. Prices start from $15 for ages 4 to 12, $25 for ages 13 and up, $20 for seniors and $0 for ages 3 and under.
